newsitem.title: USA: Santa Fe Pacific to meet with Newmont Mining.
newsitem.headline: Santa Fe Pacific to meet with Newmont Mining.

text.p: Santa Fe Pacific Gold Corp said Monday that it will meet with Newmont Mining Corp, which has made a hostile bid for the gold mining and exploration company.
However, Santa Fe said it has made no determination to end its friendly merger agreement with Homestake Mining Co.

In a release, the company said it is meeting with Newmont Mining "so that any future decisions or actions are consistent with and advance the best interests of Santa Fe Pacific Gold shareholders." It said there are no assurances that any action will come from the meeting.
Last week Newmont Mining sweetened its hostile bid to acquire Santa Fe, offering to 0.4 Newmont shares for each Santa Fe share, after Santa Fe rejected an earlier offer of 0.33 share.
Newmont Mining closed Friday at 41. Santa Fe closed at 15-7/8.
A friendly merger with Homestake, announced in December, would give Santa Fe shareholders 1.115 Homestake shares for each Santa Fe share. Homestake closed Friday at 14.
